# Event: Bounty Hunting: Head Hunting & Bounty Hunting: Routine Hunting

![Event: Bounty Hunting: Head Hunting & Bounty Hunting: Routine Hunting](/uploads/594_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

With the Burning Springs update on December 2nd, 2025, the map will be expanded west into the Ohio desert. There are 25 new locations here and there are plenty of outlaws to hunt in bounty events. The ghoul himself gives you bounty hunting jobs in Highway Town.

**TL;DR: The new legendary mods only drop from these two events.**

You will be introduced to the bounty hunting system during the Burning Springs quest series. There are 2 different bounty hunts here:

## 1. Bounty Hunting: Headhunting

This event is a publicly announced event that starts with a trigger (similar to Cryptic). You can start it in 2 different ways:

- Pay 5000 caps to the ghoul
- Hang wanted posters on the bounty board*Acquired from routine hunts*

![](/uploads/expected-changes-for-burning-springs-update-on-2nd-dec-2025.jpg)

Once you have triggered one of these triggers, your public event starts and everyone can help you complete the event.

### The following event locations are possible:

-Ash Cave
- Athens
- The Chop Shop
- Dino Peaks mini golf
-Fort Steuben
- Train depot

There are also 7 different groups of opponents.

### Bounty Hunting Rewards

- 1500 XP
- 3-5 legendary modules
- 1-3 improved lures
- 2 government bonds
- 1 legendary 1-3 star item
 - All legendary mod + new Burning Springs mods
 - Armor, power armor, ranged or melee weapon
- (inactive) Option for 4 star items*Server-side activation possible*

See article about the new legendary mods:

![New legendary mods in the Burning Springs Update](/uploads//tn_nukaknights_article_teaser_de_577.jpg) 

### New legendary mods in the Burning Springs update

## 2. Bounty Hunting: Routine hunting

The routing hunt events are small tasks, similar to the daily tasks, that you can complete solo. You will only meet one outlaw, who poses a smaller challenge.

You start a routine hunt by picking up a wanted poster at the ghoul's table in the **Last Resort** in **Highway Town**.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-bounty-hunt-grunt-hunt-20251003110635-1.jpg)

### Routine Hunt Rewards

You start with 1* opponents in the routine hunt, after 10 routed hunts the 2* routine hunts are unlocked by completing the challenge. After another 50, the 3* routine hunts will be unlocked.

- 1000 XP
- 1-3 legendary modules
- Wanted poster (for bounty hunting)*Note: Always put wanted posters in your storage box when you don't want to start a bounty hunt, so you have a higher chance of getting new ones.*
- 1 legendary 1-3 star item
 - All legendary mod + new Burning Springs mods
 - Armor, power armor, ranged or melee weapon

See article about the new legendary mods:

![New legendary mods in the Burning Springs Update](/uploads//tn_nukaknights_article_teaser_de_577.jpg)
